verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents first-party workflow automation with flows and triggered events that run "without you having to lift a finger." It also offers background automations such as lead scoring and automatic lead assignment, and its MCP server lets an AI assistant automate workflows. The evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: detailed docs on automation triggers, conditions and actions, evidence of AI-driven autonomous agents beyond rule-based flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
